points.quote: A document is a Yjs `Doc`. The BlockSuite block tree lives inside it as Y.Maps.
the frontend runs `applyUpdate(doc, update, NBSTORE_ORIGIN)`, so the editor changes without echoing the update back.
On disk and on the wire the data is binary Yjs updates, plus merged snapshots
The storage layer is `@affine/nbstore` ... Web (IndexedDB): one database per workspace ... Desktop (Electron) and mobile: a SQLite file per workspace
Other edits become `save` jobs that call `pushDocUpdate` on local storage. ... Local-only workspaces ... skip the cloud peer and keep everything in the local store.
